description: This file defines function prototypes and include guards for preparing an environment for diffing files in the LibXDiff library. It includes function declarations for environment setup and cleanup related to file differencing.

methods.name: xdl_prepare_env
methods.description: Prepares the environment for diffing two files, initializing the diff environment structure.

methods.name: xdl_free_env
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the diff environment.
